Question: Two fair dice, each with at least \(6\) faces are rolled. On each face of each die is printed a distinct integer from \(1\) to the number of faces on that die, inclusive. The probability of rolling a sum of \(7\) is \(\dfrac34\) of the probability of rolling a sum of \(10,\) and the probability of rolling a sum of \(12\) is \(\dfrac{1}{12}.\) What is the least possible number of faces on the two dice combined?
